summary: viper-1.7 memory-safe phone notebook: the owner's crash was Colab host RAM (12.7 GB) during the 22.7 GB fp32 UMT5 load. Fix ported from the proven rivas-vega/wan2.1-t4-colab recipe: 4-bit NF4 text encoder on GPU, fp16 DiT, fp32 tiled+sliced VAE, HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET, glibc mallopt/malloc_trim, UniPC flow_shift 3.0 at 480p, pipeline deleted before upscale, Real-ESRGAN -> ffmpeg lanczos fallback. Test shot cut to 33 frames (~2 s, ~6 min render); mobile --max-frames added. 181 tests OK, validate 25/0, tag colab-test-04.
